detail.title: Parking Space Detection Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC214-PH5B-F3 Parking Space Detection Camera Key Points • High Sensitivity and Clarity: HD 2MP camera with 1/2.8"" CMOS, suitable for environment with low illumination • Advanced Multi-Spot Detection: 1 lens with up to 99% recognition accuracy. Simultaneously detecting up to 2 parking spaces, delivering comprehensive coverage and precise monitoring. • Smart Event Analysis: Intelligent detection of parking space status, such as illegal parking, smoke detection, line crossing detection and parking in restricted areas. • Easy deployment: Network wiring with easy connection, installation, and maintenance. • Robust Connectivity: 1 RS-485 for external indicators, 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet Port, H.264, H.265, and MJPEG flexible coding, PoE power supply and 12 VDC. • Built-in LED: 7 indicator lights colors, adjustable according to parking space type (charging spaces, handicapped spaces, etc.). • PON Support: Suitable for long-distance power supply, reducing wiring costs. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Basic.Parking Space Indicator: 1, 7 customizable colors (red, yellow, blue, green, cyan, white, and pink)
Basic.Image Resolution: 1920 (H) × 1080 (V) (OSD black background is not calculated in the pixels)
Basic.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 1106 kbps–8847 kbps H.265: 1106 kbps–8847 kbps MJPEG: 3318 kbps–26542 kbps
Basic.Video Frame Rate: PAL: Main stream (1920 × 1080@25 fps, 1280 × 720@25 fps), sub stream (704 × 576@25 fps) NTSC: Main stream (1920 × 1080@30 fps, 1280 × 720@30 fps), sub stream (704 × 408@30 fps)
Basic.Exposure Mode: Auto; Manual (select from shutter values or customize shutter range)

Function.Security: Authorized username and password, MAC address binding, HTTPS encryption, IEEE 802.1x, and network access control
Function.OSD Overlay: Time, address, parking space No., parking space status, plate number, vehicle model, vehicle logo and color
Function.Alarm Event: Illegal access, security error and other events
Function.Image Tampering Prevention: Verifies watermarks in videos and images
Function.Network Protocol: TCP/IP; HTTP; DHCP; RTSP; NTP; HTTPS

Intelligence.Vehicle Recognition: Recognizes vehicle model, logo, color, and plate number, and collects metadata for unlicensed vehicles. Vehicle recognition rate is over 99.5% and plate recognition rate is over 99%
Intelligence.Parking Space Status Detection: Yes, the indicator color is customizable
Intelligence.Illegal Parking Detection: Detects illegal parking events including vehicle occupies two parking spaces, non-allowlist vehicle occupies parking space, and small vehicle parked in large vehicle's space.

Port.Network Port: 2 × RJ-45 Ethernet ports, 100 M network transmission
Port.Power Output: 12 VDC ± 10% voltage output, ≤1 A current output
